source_scope_note: The primary four-helper comparison qualifies 599b748319 against fd30bc6ffd on common main 04dd50548a. The later main merge c532682337 preserves the lake execution files. The final e23de32d9c change only admits request projection plans when more than one hit can reuse them; this separate follow-up compares that guard against c532682337 on main 1cfa5178d4. Earlier stage measurements are not retroactively relabeled as final-runtime measurements.

negative_control.case: wide covering projection with unavailable original Parquet

early_cluster.prior_probe_note: Prior occurrence/block counters come from the temporary v9 review probe; latency comparisons use separately pinned same-main executables.

projection_cache.single_hit_policy: Do not build a projection plan for one hit; avoid unused plan allocation. The separate comparison does not demonstrate a material latency gain.

cache_cleanup.user_uv_prune: Stopped only the owned cleanup and uv child after they blocked on .cache/uv/.lock held by unrelated stale uv jobs; those unrelated jobs were left running. No cleanup overlapped measurements.
cache_cleanup.qualification_startup_storage_guard: One follow-up startup stopped before any query at 13 GiB free, below the 16-GiB safety floor. After task-owned superseded static libraries were removed, 25 GiB was available and all measured runs completed. Production disk safeguards were not disabled.

The 3 extended cases also pass in a focused run (19.52 seconds). Fixture development corrected automatic-metadata expectations, a stopword and an unindexed metadata predicate; runtime bytes did not change.

source_metadata_correction.contract: Wildcard and exclusion-only source payloads contain physical columns. Virtual _id is explicit, identity sorting uses hit identity, and declared _type values/nulls survive covering and accepted-row hydration. Default routing types do not invent or overwrite source data.
source_metadata_correction.negative_control: The old Parquet path returned physical columns while the optimized covering path injected synthetic fields; the strict comparison stopped rather than accepting different outputs. Final helpers require exact physical-source equivalence.

latest_main.conflict: Combined both append-only design sections in zig/REMOTE_TABLE_SERVING.md; retained main cloud-retention design and branch execution/projection contracts.

deadline_qualification.note: The 50-ms success bound was host-contention-sensitive during a concurrent rebuild; one pre-merge 599b run passed 47 cases and timed out that request. Final E2E runs after builds finish. Native block/byte/memory budgets and independent paired comparisons qualify efficiency; product timeout behavior is unchanged.

final_e2e.command: PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 TZ=UTC ANTFLY_E2E_FULL_LAKE=1 ANTFLY_BIN=FINAL_FROZEN_ANTFLY python -B -m pytest zig/e2e/antfly/test_lake_archive_qualification.py zig/e2e/antfly/test_iceberg_sql.py -n 2 -q
final_e2e.source_shapes: Wildcard and exclusion-only masks contain physical fields only; explicit _id matches hit identity, undeclared _type is not invented, both directions of physical ID sort and ascending public _id sort survive restart with original Parquet unavailable. Dense mixed highlights use two non-stopwords and native text row selection.
